detector.description: Alerts when at least 1 detector is aborted for the last 5h
detector.name: Splunk Operational - Detectors aborted
detector.programText:
A = data('sf.org.numDetectorsAborted', rollup='sum').sum(over='5h').publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(0)), auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('Splunk Operational - Detectors aborted')

rules.description: The value of Detectors Aborted is above 0.
